correctness.rationale: Bargetz et al. identify finite 1-homogeneous metrics with vertex-transitive distance colorings and prove \(\delta(X)\le(|S_X|+|X|)/2\). Edmonds proves that the number of odd color valencies on even \(n\) vertices is at most \(\iota(n)=n/2+n_2/2-1\). Positive singleton distances are valency-one colors, so \(|S_X|-1\le\iota(n)\), yielding \(\delta(X)\le(3n+n_2)/4\). Bargetz et al.'s Example 6.10 attains this value for every even \(n\), and their Proposition 6.7 covers odd \(n\). Boundary cases \(n=1,2\) and powers of two agree with the formula.
